Deep horizontal channels give the Modern Padded Horizontal Channel Headboard a plush, tactile finish that still reads as clean and modern. It is padded, built on a wooden frame, and handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Deep horizontal channel stitching
  • Padded surface on a wooden frame
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between this and the Elite Horizontal headboard?

The channels here are deeper and softer. The Elite Horizontal Panel Headboard has wide, flatter horizontal panels.

Which fabrics are available?

Colours and fabrics can be chosen from our range; the product photos show cream. Free swatches are available.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Modern Panel Storage Bed has a vertical panel headboard in cream fabric as standard, on a divan base with a drawer. It is a straightforward, versatile option that fits most bedroom styles without dominating the room.

Key features

  • Vertical panel headboard, cream fabric as standard
  • Divan base with built-in pull-out storage drawer
  • Sturdy solid frame construction
  • Handmade to order in West Yorkshire, UK

Sizes

Available in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a sturdy wooden frame. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke fabric, colour and size requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Delivery & assembly

Delivery across Great Britain is free and made by our own team, usually within 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99 when you order.

Warranty & payment

Every bed comes with a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay. Questions? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

FAQ

Is it only available in cream?

Cream is the standard shown. Other colours and fabrics are available, and free swatches can be sent.

What sizes does the Modern Panel Storage Bed with Drawer come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I order a different colour or fabric?

Yes. It comes in a wide range of colours in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free swatches can be sent.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3 to 5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

Browse our full range of handmade storage beds for more headboard styles.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Modern Wide Panel Bed is an upholstered vertical panel bed with broader panel widths than our standard design. Fewer, wider sections across the headboard give a bolder, more graphic look, and it is handcrafted in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Wide vertical panel headboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Wooden frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £259.00; Small Double (4FT) £259.00; Double (4FT6) £259.00; King (5FT) £259.00; Super King (6FT) £259.00. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame with a slatted base. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet. Bespoke fabric and colour requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How is the Wide Panel different from the Aurora?

It has fewer, wider panels across the headboard, so the look is bolder than the standard Aurora vertical panel bed.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Contact us to confirm options for this design.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
